echo_sets.name: Law of Harmony (3pc) + Sierra Gale (2pc)
echo_sets.note: Most of Qiuyuan's attacks count as Echo Skills; Law of Harmony grants 30% Heavy ATK DMG and stacking team Echo DMG buffs while Sierra Gale adds Aero DMG.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds (5pc)
echo_sets.note: Pure support route: 22% ATK buff to the next character plus Energy Regen; functional but outclassed by Law of Harmony for his kit.

echo_sets.name: Law of Harmony (3pc) + Energy Regen (2pc)
echo_sets.note: Sacrifice some personal damage to guarantee Liberation uptime with minimal field time; best for a pure buff-bot role.

build.fast_path: Build Qiuyuan as an Aero Sub-DPS buffer with Emerald Sentence (or Emerald of Genesis) and 3pc Law of Harmony + 2pc Sierra Gale (4-3-3-1-1), prioritizing Crit Rate to 65% to unlock his Liberation's team Crit DMG buff, then Echo-Skill and heavy-attack damage for his personal contribution.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald Sentence
ranked_weapons.note: Signature: ATK%, 40% Heavy Attack DMG after casting Echo Skill, and 20% party-wide Echo Skill DMG on Intro/Outro — tailor-made for his kit.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
ranked_weapons.note: Standard 5-star stat stick: Crit Rate substat helps hit the 65% threshold, plus Energy Regen and ATK% from its passive.

ranked_weapons.name: Red Spring
ranked_weapons.note: Crit Rate substat option with 12% ATK on Basic Attack damage; Qiuyuan gains little from the rest of its passive.

ranked_weapons.name: Lumingloss
ranked_weapons.note: Best F2P option: large Heavy Attack DMG increase and ATK% substat; needs the 65% Crit Rate built from echoes.

stat_priorities.note: Hit 65% Crit Rate to unlock the Liberation's team Crit DMG buff; Crit DMG is the alternative if rate is already capped.
Two 3-cost pieces, both Aero DMG Bonus.

profile.role_note: Hybrid Echo-Skill buffer; niche pick for Echo-skill DPS teams (Sigrika, Phrolova, Galbrena).

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Qiuyuan is a niche but strong Echo-Skill buffer who elevates Sigrika, Phrolova, and Galbrena teams without needing his signature weapon. Pull only if you own one of those Echo-centric carries and want a second Echo-team option. Skip if you already have Lucilla, who covers the same niche more consistently.

teams.name: Premium: Sigrika + Qiuyuan + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Open with Shorekeeper's liberation and buffs, then swap to Qiuyuan: Intro gives 400 Forte, enhanced basic attacks build to 600, cast Resonance Liberation for the 30% Crit DMG buff, then unleash the 3 Forte Heavy Attacks. Outro into Sigrika for a 50% Echo Skill DMG amplification window and finish with her full damage rotation.

members.name: Phrolova
members.note: Echo-centric main DPS; benefits massively from Qiuyuan's buffs and multiple Echo casts.

members.name: Qiuyuan
members.note: Standard buffer rotation; cast Echo Skill before Liberation to privilege Enhanced Hecate attacks.

members.name: Buling
members.note: Budget support who keeps the team healed and fed with concerto energy.

teams.name: Budget: Phrolova + Qiuyuan + Buling
teams.rotation: Buling opens with her buff and healing setup, then Qiuyuan takes the field: Intro for 400 Forte, basic attack chains to full Forte, Resonance Liberation, then the 3 Forte Heavy Attacks. Time the Echo Skill cast just before Liberation so Phrolova's Enhanced Hecate attacks land inside the buff window, then swap to Phrolova for her full rotation.

sequences.verdict: S0 support kit is complete. S2 is the support value stop, S3 unlocks a DPS mode, S6 is whale territory.
